038package dev.visdb.seesaw.table;
039
040/**
041 * The SsDataValue interface specifies methods for SsTableModel to retrieve the
042value for primary column in JTable.
043 */
044public interface SsDataValue {
045  /**
046   * Returns the value for the primary column in the JTable (RowSet used for
047   * building the JTable). When addition of a row is taking place in the JTable,
048   * SsTableModel tries to insert a primary key value in to that row returned by
049   * this function.
050   *
051   * @return the value for the primary key column.
052   */
053  public Object getPrimaryColumnValue();
054
055} // end public interface SsDataValue {
